To serve your docs from your own address, add the domain in Nibleaf, then add two DNS records at your domain provider. [1]

1. Open Settings → Custom domain, enter your domain (for example `docs.example.com`) and select Add domain. [1]
2. Nibleaf shows a CNAME record, which points your address to your site, and a TXT record, which proves you own the domain. [1]
3. Add both records in your provider's DNS settings. Use Copy DNS record to avoid typing mistakes, then select Check again. [1]

DNS changes usually take a few minutes but can take up to 24 hours. When it's ready, the domain shows Connected — secure (HTTPS) ✓. [2]

You need to be the site's Owner or an Admin, and a subdomain such as `docs.example.com` works best. [3]
